name: kriko-extension
description: Tests for the listing scraper and extension panel.

scripts._comment_test: Double quotes, not single. npm runs this through cmd.exe on Windows, which does not strip single quotes -- so node was handed a pattern containing literal ' characters, matched nothing, and reported `tests 0 / fail 0` with exit 0. The gate's node leg was green and vacuous on the only host that runs the gate, hiding all 157 of these tests. tools/gate.sh now also fails a run that reports zero tests, because a passing suite and an empty one must not look alike.
